actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Zoho Invoice action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Zoho Invoice connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

input.name: estimate_number
input.label: Estimate number
input.hint: Mandatory if estimate number auto generation is set to false else leave blank

input.name: send
input.label: Send
input.hint: Send the estimate to the contact person associated with the estimate

input.name: date
input.label: Date
input.hint: Date the invoice is created

input.name: exchange_rate
input.label: Exchange rate
input.hint: Equivalent to 1 Base currency

input.name: discount
input.label: Discount
input.hint: Can be either in % or in amount. E.g. 12.5% or 190
